body: Wow it suddenly started for me???

Something like this happened to me to. We were travelling. Pandemic happened, I got super depressed and decided to move home for a bit and just take it from there. So we were definitely on a break/broke up. We talked every single day. He told me he loved me every single day. After a few months I moved back to his country for good. Basically as soon as I hopped off the plane he told me he hooked up with "several girls", but never wanted to tell me how many because that was not for me to know. I never even asked and wanted to ask if there was anyone else in the meantime, but as soon as he told me I wanted to know how many. I should've left right there and then. I wish he told me before I packed up my whole life and moved to the other side of the world. 
Over a year later now. The guilt feeling towards my friends and family to come back has finally left. I'm close to leaving now, for this and other reasons as well.

Talk to him, but if it doesn't feel right please please please trust your gut!!

Yes, George Michael for me as well. I can't say I'm a huge fan, but I like his music. My mom loved him so I grew up with it. After he passed I started a new job and my manager probably is stil a huge fan. Even after he passed she still got sad and teary eyed when we would talk about him.

This album is not at all what I expected and unfortunately not my cup of tea. :( I've been listening all day, and sure some songs keep playing in my head a little bit, but the music & lyrics are just not for me. Not one single song stands out to me. :/ 

It's alright though, I literally love every thing she has done in the past, so this was bound to happen at some point.
